seo.title: Rooms in Oroslavje | Hotel Zagi near Zagreb
seo.description: Double, triple and family rooms with Wi-Fi, air conditioning and balconies at Hotel Zagi in Oroslavje, with free parking. Book directly with us.

hero.title: Rooms for a peaceful stay in Oroslavje
hero.lead: 60 modern rooms for couples, families and business guests – around thirty minutes from Zagreb.

image.alt: View from a hotel room balcony over the green hills of Zagorje

intro.heading: Comfort, calm and everything you need
paragraphs: Hotel Zagi has 60 modern rooms. Each has a private bathroom, a TV with satellite channels, a direct-dial telephone and internet access.
All rooms feature a “Smart room” system and smoke detectors. Your car will be safe in the spacious free car park next to the hotel, which also takes coaches for group arrivals.

sections.heading: Other room types
paragraphs: We also offer single rooms and a family room with a balcony for up to seven people. Check availability and prices for your dates when booking, or get in touch.
list: Single room – 1 person, from €33 per night
Family room with balcony – up to 7 people, from €120 per night

cta.heading: Travelling as a group or with family?
cta.text: For group arrivals, sports clubs and longer stays, we will put together a tailored offer.
